context: Evaluates correct use of the wormhole velocity control action callbacks (accelerate, decelerate, setTargetVelocity, stop) obtained via useWormholeActions. Tests that speed boundaries defined by NAV_CONFIG are respected and that the stop action correctly zeroes velocity.

checklist.name: Actions Hook Usage
checklist.description: useWormholeActions() is used to obtain the accelerate, decelerate, setTargetVelocity, and stop callbacks

checklist.name: Accelerate/Decelerate
checklist.description: accelerate() and decelerate() are called directly without arguments, relying on NAV_CONFIG.KEY_ACCELERATION step size

checklist.name: Velocity Clamping
checklist.description: setTargetVelocity is used with values that respect NAV_CONFIG.MIN_SPEED (-1) and NAV_CONFIG.MAX_SPEED (1) boundaries, either by clamping input or letting the action clamp internally

checklist.name: Stop Action
checklist.description: stop() is called to immediately halt movement (sets velocity to 0), distinct from setting targetVelocity to 0

checklist.name: State Reading
checklist.description: useWormholeState() is used to read current velocity or targetVelocity for displaying or reacting to speed changes
